service.description: A group's Overview: its landing text (html, the Markdown file landingPath of the repository landingRepositoryId at its default branch, rendered and cleaned; null when there is none or the caller may not view that repository, and the page shows the group's description), the file's repository and path and its edit page, the pinned repositories, the latest published release of the group's repositories and those below it, news (the latest topics of the group's news category, as the caller may read them) and activity (pushes, merged merge requests and releases of the repositories the caller views, newest first, at most 10). Relative links of the text are left as written: the page makes them links of the repository.

Set a group's landing text (landingRepositoryPath and landingPath: a Markdown file at that repository's default branch; both empty clear it) and its news category (newsContactListId; empty clears it), by an Owner with a confirmed address, with expectedRevision. Unprocessable when the file is not there, when the repository is narrower than the group (a members-only landing for a public group) or hidden, and when the category is not the site's or is narrower than the group.

A page of a repository's docs (refPath: a branch, a tag or a commit id and a path in the docs directory, SmithyRepository.docsPath, docs by default; empty: README.md of the directory at the default branch; a directory: its README.md): the Markdown file rendered and cleaned, with stable heading anchors (the lower-cased text joined with -), its title (the first heading, else the file's name), its headings, a table of contents from the directory's tree (a directory's README.md is its index, a directory a section; at most 500 files, 5 levels), its edit page at a branch, and the branches and tags for a picker. Not Found for a repository whose docs are off, a path outside the docs directory, a file that is not Markdown, and a repository the caller may not view. The rendering is cached by the file's blob id.

The releases of a repository, or of the repositories of a group and those below it that the caller views (repositoryId or groupId), newest first, paged: Mantle's releases (WetRelease) linked to a tag of the repository, each with its notes rendered, its assets and the topic that announced it. A draft is listed only to a Maintainer.
A release by its tag, with the source archives of the tag, the component its tag's component.xml names, and canEdit for a Maintainer. Not Found for a draft but to a Maintainer.

Make the release of a tag (operationId) or change it (expectedRevision), by a Maintainer with a confirmed address, in a repository that is not archived: name, notes (Markdown, through the gate), published. A new release is a WetRelease of the repository's project named as the tag's version, linked to the tag. Publishing copies the artifacts of the tag's latest successful pipeline run that the release lacks by name; announce posts a topic in the news category of the nearest group that has one, linked to the release. Unprocessable for a tag the repository does not have.
Withdraw a release (expectedRevision), by a Maintainer: the release is cancelled, its link to the tag ends and its assets are removed. The tag stays; storeRelease makes its release again.

Add an asset to a release, by a Maintainer with a confirmed address: attachmentId (the caller's staged repositoryFile upload that passed scanning), artifactId (an artifact of a pipeline run of the tag) or imageName (a container image's name); name defaults to the file's. nameTaken for a name the release has; quotaExceeded when the repository's assets would pass its namespace's Git LFS limit; Unprocessable for an upload that has not passed scanning, an artifact of another run and a file over 256 MiB. The same operationId answers the first result.
Remove an asset and its file, by a Maintainer.

An asset's file as a download (the facade streams file and location), for a caller who views the release: anyone who views the repository for a published one, a Maintainer for a draft. Not Found for an image's name, which has no file.

The component directory (Explore, design-smithy §13.4): the repositories the caller views whose root has a component.xml at the default branch, of the site or below a group (groupId), searched by query in the component's name and the repository's path, paged: name, version, dependsOn, repositoryPath, description and the latest published release's tag.

A group's addons.xml in the format ./moq component-get reads: a repository element of this server's clone and archive addresses, and a component element for each component of the group and those below it that the caller views (public ones only for no user), with its group path, default branch, latest release tag as its version, and its component.xml name where it differs from the repository's. At most 500.

One box over the public projections (design-smithy §13.5): repositories, groups, components, issues, merge requests, docs pages (the docs directory at the default branch) and forum topics (the forum's own search), each kept by its own rule before a title, a snippet or a count is given: a confidential issue only to who reads it, a held issue or merge request to nobody here, a private repository's items only to who views it. types (comma separated) narrows the kinds; groupId or repositoryId narrows the place. Each kind gives at most limit (10 when several kinds are asked) results; a search of one kind is paged. Unprocessable for a query under 2 characters.
The site's table of old paths, for its owners and operators: searched by query in the old host and path and the target, filtered by source (site, forum, github, manual), paged.

Make a redirect (operationId) or change one (redirectId), by a site owner or operator: oldHost (empty: the site's own hosts), oldPath (a path starting with /, or a whole address whose host is taken as oldHost), targetPath, note. nameTaken for an old path the table has; targetInvalid (Unprocessable) for a target that is not a path of this site or an https address of one of its hosts, and one that is its own old path.
Remove a redirect, by a site owner or operator.

Import a CSV of old addresses for a site's move, by a site owner or operator: one redirect a line, old (a path, or a whole address whose host becomes oldHost), target and an optional note; a first line whose first field is not a path or an address is a header. source names where they came from (site, forum, github; manual by default). An old path the table has takes the new target, so an import runs twice safely. Each line stands alone: one that fails is named in failedList with its reason, and the rest go on. At most 5,000 lines.

The target of an old path of a site (SmithyRedirect): for the request's host first, then for the site's own hosts (no oldHost); the path as it came, then without a trailing slash, then in lower case. No targetPath out when there is none. status is 301.

actions.script: const found = ec.resource.script("component://mr-mantle/service/mantle/smithy/Smithy.js").resolveRedirect({siteId, host, path}) if (found) { targetPath = found.targetPath; status = found.status }
